propositions: Git 2.38+ floor for merge-tree --write-tree capability is not declared or enforced, allowing under-floor clients to run tests without clear diagnostic or skip
The two-clone enrichment regression (bug 8185) may silently not execute on older Git versions, creating vacuous test coverage similar to vacuous guards in 34c2 and 8a5e
Supported Git version floor must be single-sourced and consistent across contributor docs, CI workflows, and test configuration to prevent drift
Test enforcement must fail the session (abort before collection) rather than skip, so under-floor clients cannot run degraded tests
The 8185 regression must remain collected and executed on every gating CI environment with explicit version verification per runner
merge-tree regression tests must not be guarded by skip machinery, and the codebase must be searched to detect any such guards and fail loudly if found
